notes.title: Book of Adventum Demo Update 1.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Book of Adventum Demo update 1.1.1.0:

- Spiders can now be stun-locked with the Funky Chicken crossbow.
- ”Ventum est Agrente” -quest item beacon added.
- ”Ventum est Agrente” -quest mission terminal fixed.
- Quest description journal bug fixed.
- Russian localization for ”Workshop” added for the Workshop tutorial.
- Workshop Jukebox titles fixed.

notes.title: Book of Adventum Demo update 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Book of Adventum Demo update 1.1.0.0

- Lootballs emit a beacon, which is activated a second after the ball is dropped.

- The door opening mechanism has been upgraded.

- Inventory and pause menu is now easier to use with a mouse. Healing items and items used to counter status effects can be now used with a mouse.

- When drinking coffee in the workshop, the coffee disappears from the cup.

- Certain collectable ingredients locations have changed closer to the cabin in Nexus Forest.

- The wall and the ceiling in the Cabin Basement corridor fixed.

- Roadsigns are now easier to read.

- The bird drones are now changing location according to the active quest. (This means the "main quest". Not applicable to side quests or maintenance quests.)

- A light source added to a specific quest location at the Skjoldpadda Refueling Station.

- Main Menu audio balance fixed.

- Credits video audio balance fixed.

- Performance optimization in Container Cave.
